justification: The available evidence does not support attributing fairness to the system in the deployment context because the documentation provides only overall performance metrics and complaint counts, while omitting group-specific error rates and the demographic composition of the validation dataset. Without subgroup evidence, fairness cannot be assessed for different populations in the described deployment.
evidence_used: Group-specific error rates are not reported in the validation documentation.
The demographic composition of the validation dataset is not included in the documentation available to the evaluator.
During the first eight weeks of limited deployment, 14,310 applications were processed.
Seven complaints concerning lending decisions were registered; none had completed investigation at the date of evaluation.
limitations: No group-specific performance metrics are provided.
No demographic breakdown of the validation dataset is provided.
Complaint investigations were not complete, so the complaints do not establish or refute fairness.
Overall metrics alone do not demonstrate fairness across groups in this deployment context.
